name: Parliament of Lebanon (Majlis al-Nuwwab)
notes: Unicameral, 128 seats split equally between Christians and Muslims. Seats by alliance and party from the results of the 15 May 2022 election (Interior Ministry figures announced 17 May 2022) as tabulated by Wikipedia; the groups add up to 128. In March 2026 Parliament extended its own term by two years instead of holding the May 2026 election, so this is still the sitting chamber. Blocs move after elections and the Parliament's own member list (lp.gov.lb) was not read, so no member is marked as sitting and no seat is lit.
